custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the shell texture. Real mud turtles have distinct scutes (plates). If the shell looks like a single smooth, unsegmented dome, it is likely an AI artifact. Also, check the eye reflection; AI eyes often lack realistic environmental reflections or have unnatural glints.
